project_type: Laravel 11 (PHP) monolith built by merging an existing static Tailwind-CDN + vanilla-JS single-page Daihatsu dealership site into one Laravel app. Public page served by Blade; admin dashboard is Breeze Blade + resource controllers.
language: PHP 8.2 (Laravel 11) + Blade; existing front-end is vanilla JS (ES5-style IIFE modules) + Tailwind via CDN.
build_system: Composer 2.9.7 for PHP deps; artisan for app tasks. Node v24.15.0 present but npm build is OPTIONAL (both admin and public load Tailwind from the CDN, not Vite output). Laravel scaffolded via `composer create-project laravel/laravel` into a TEMP sibling dir then merged into the project root (create-project refuses a non-empty target).
test_framework: PHPUnit/Pest shipped with Laravel 11; run via `php artisan test`. Prefer feature tests over a MySQL/sqlite test DB. The key regression guard is a feature test on GET / asserting the bootstrapped window.App.* shapes.
verification_instructions: Run from project root in PowerShell (';' sequences but does NOT stop on error — check each step or guard with '; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { break }'). Bootstrap: `php artisan key:generate` ; `php artisan storage:link` ; `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` ; `php artisan test` ; `php artisan serve`. Row counts after seed (via the MySQL CLI, full quoted path) must be cars=9, category_styles=4, quiz_questions=4, quiz_options=14, wheel_prizes=6, corner_images=3, hero_slides=4, testimonials=6, users=1. GET / must contain `App.CARS = [` (9 entries) and `App.CAT_STYLE = {` (object, NOT `[`). XAMPP MySQL must be running.

key_patterns: The 13 body-bottom JS modules load in EXACT order: data.js, utils.js, ui.js, hero-slider.js, catalog.js, compare.js, car-detail.js, quiz.js, testimonials.js, calculator.js, corner-widget.js, spin-wheel.js, main.js — the data.js slot is REPLACED by @include('partials.app-data'); the other 12 keep order, wrapped in {{ asset('js/xxx.js') }}. js/tailwind.config.js is a HEAD script (after the Tailwind CDN, before css/style.css) — NOT a body module. Verified JS contracts the @json bootstrap MUST satisfy: catalog.js uses car.accent[0] (badge pill bg + card-top --c1) and car.accent[1] (--c2), so accent is a 2-element array of non-null hex; CAT_STYLE[car.category] is indexed as a keyed OBJECT (never emit an array — do NOT call ->values() on it); quiz.js does `for (const model in opt.score)` so score is a model->points object map; spin-wheel.js does String(short).split('\n') so short keeps real newlines; cars emit NO desc key (car-detail.js falls back to its own CAT_DESC map); main.js calls App.renderCars(App.CARS) synchronously so the bootstrap must be inline @json, not an async API. FALLBACK_IMG is defined in utils.js. accent split into accent1/accent2 columns (char(7)); quiz score normalized into quiz_option_scores join rows; cars.img/hero_slides.img/testimonials.img/corner_images.src are NOT NULL; image fields accept http(s):// URL OR img/ OR storage/ path OR an uploaded file.
